name: Missed Call Text Back (No BS AI template)

parameters.content:
## Missed Call Text Back
Built by Bobby Ve, No BS AI.

1. Edit the **Settings** node.
2. Add a Basic Auth credential to **Send Text** (Twilio Account SID + Auth Token).
3. Point your phone number's call status webhook to **Call Ended**, and its text webhook to **Text Reply In**.

Every text ends with: Reply STOP to opt out.
